task_description: Generate a face-centered cubic (FCC) lattice structure for Aluminum (Al) using LAMMPS with a lattice constant of 4.05 angstrom. The simulation should use metal units, define a 5x5x5 simulation box, set periodic boundary conditions to True, and save all the coordinates and lattice parameters in structure.xyz file. Create a directory /results/lattice_generation/task_1/ and save the following inside it: The input file used for the simulation, the output log file generated by LAMMPS, and the generated XYZ file containing the lattice structure.

subtasks.name: directory_generation
subtasks.description: Create the given directory. If it is done successfully, print the absolute location of the directory as the final output.

subtasks.name: lattice_generation
